kpis.description_fr: Capacité ENR installée groupe (#1 mondial renewables generator). Italie + Espagne + LatAm + USA.
kpis.description_en: Group renewable installed capacity (#1 global renewables generator). Italy + Spain + LatAm + US.

kpis.description_fr: Clients finaux 5 pays (Italie, Espagne, Brésil, Chili, Colombie). Plus grande base utility privée monde.
kpis.description_en: End users in 5 countries (Italy, Spain, Brazil, Chile, Colombia). Largest private utility base worldwide.

kpis.description_fr: Clients distribution Italie (E-Distribuzione). Monopole régulé, base revenue stable WACC ARERA.
kpis.description_en: Italy distribution customers (E-Distribuzione). Regulated monopoly, stable revenue ARERA WACC base.

kpis.description_fr: Plan capex 2024-2026 (€36Md, 70% networks + ENR). Discipline post-stratégie 'Selective' Cattaneo CEO.
kpis.description_en: 2024-2026 capex plan (€36B, 70% networks + renewables). Discipline post 'Selective' Cattaneo CEO strategy.

kpis.description_fr: Levier réduit via cessions (LatAm Peru, Brésil distribution). Bilan reset post-2022 énergie crisis.
kpis.description_en: Reduced leverage via disposals (Peru, Brazil distribution LatAm). Balance sheet reset post-2022 energy crisis.

kpis_story.description_fr: Cessions €21Md 2023-2024 (Peru, Argentina, Romania, Brazil distribution Sao Paulo). Focus core markets Italy + Iberia.
kpis_story.description_en: €21B disposals 2023-2024 (Peru, Argentina, Romania, Brazil Sao Paulo distribution). Focus core Italy + Iberia markets.

kpis_story.description_fr: ARERA WACC reset 2024 plus favorable post-rates. Capex networks accélère: smart meters 2.0 + grid digitalization.
kpis_story.description_en: ARERA WACC 2024 reset more favorable post-rates. Networks capex accelerates: smart meters 2.0 + grid digitalization.

_notes: ENEL.MI = Enel, #1 utility EU + #1 mondial renewables. Modèle intégré régulé + ENR + retail liberalized.
